toff.name: The Toff
toff.blurb: Old money, new plane, no manners. Thinks a queue is a type of hat.
toff.ttsDesign: Upper-class English man, early 30s, exaggerated Received Pronunciation, plummy and nasal with a braying laugh in the voice. Loud, confident, entitled, fast and bouncy delivery, medium pitch.
toff.sample: Terribly sorry, old bean. Not sorry at all, actually.

duchess.name: The Dowager
duchess.blurb: Has outlived three husbands and four controllers. Expects the runway to curtsey.
duchess.ttsDesign: Elderly English aristocratic woman, about 75, cut-glass Received Pronunciation, slow, deliberate and imperious, frosty and disdainful, slightly tremulous but commanding, medium-low pitch.
duchess.sample: Move aside. I was flying before you were invented.

bubba.name: Bubba
bubba.blurb: Bought his title at a county fair. Flies like he drives his pickup: sideways and happy.
bubba.ttsDesign: Rural Southern US man, about 40, thick Georgia/Alabama drawl, warm, loud and good-natured, laughing easily, relaxed rhythm with sudden whoops, medium-low pitch.
bubba.sample: Scuse me, partner, I'm a-squeezin' in!

darlene.name: Darlene
darlene.blurb: Married into royalty, kept the rhinestones. Lands like she enters a room: loudly.
darlene.ttsDesign: Loud, sassy Southern US woman, about 45, strong Tennessee twang, brassy and big-hearted, quick and punchy delivery, a cackle at the edges, medium pitch.
darlene.sample: Move it, sweet pea, Darlene's comin' through!

wingco.name: The Wing Commander
wingco.blurb: Handlebar moustache, three medals, no idea which war. Still shouts 'tally-ho' at pigeons.
wingco.ttsDesign: 1940s RAF officer, English man about 55, clipped old-fashioned Received Pronunciation like a wartime newsreel, jolly and hearty, crisp consonants, energetic, medium pitch.
wingco.sample: Bandit at six o'clock! Oh wait, that's me.

geezer.name: The Geezer
geezer.blurb: Won his barony in a card game. Swears it was all above board, guv.
geezer.ttsDesign: London Cockney man, about 35, East End accent with dropped h's and glottal stops, cheeky, fast-talking, cheerful wide-boy swagger, medium pitch.

sheila.name: Sheila
sheila.blurb: Flew in from the outback and never slowed down. Treats a runway like a suggestion.
sheila.ttsDesign: Brash Australian woman, about 35, broad Australian accent, loud, laughing, irreverent and upbeat, rising intonation, quick delivery, medium pitch.
sheila.sample: Sorry mate, too slow! See ya!

laird.name: The Laird
laird.blurb: Owns a mountain, three sheep and a grudge. Says very little, all of it rude.
laird.ttsDesign: Gruff Scottish Highland man, about 60, broad Scots accent with rolled r's, deep gravelly voice, terse and grumpy, slow then explosive, low pitch.
laird.sample: Shift, ye numpty! Laird comin' through!

heiress.name: The Heiress
heiress.blurb: Daddy bought her the plane. And the airport. And possibly you.
heiress.ttsDesign: Young American woman, about 22, Californian valley-girl accent, heavy vocal fry, bored and drawn-out, uptalk, sarcastic and unimpressed, medium-high pitch, low energy.
heiress.sample: Oh, were you landing? That's so sad.

comte.name: Le Comte
comte.blurb: His family has been disappointed by everyone since 1642. You are next.
comte.ttsDesign: French aristocrat man, about 50, strong French accent speaking English, languid, disdainful and theatrical, long sighs, smooth baritone, slow delivery.
comte.sample: Pardon. No, I am not sorry.

baronin.name: Die Baronin
baronin.blurb: Runs her estate, her family and the traffic pattern with a stopwatch.
baronin.ttsDesign: Stern German baroness, about 50, clear German accent speaking English, clipped, precise and cold, every consonant crisp, controlled energy, medium-low pitch.
baronin.sample: You were too slow. I have corrected this.

tex.name: Big Tex
tex.blurb: Struck oil, bought a title, then bought the title's neighbours. Everything's bigger, especially the ego.
tex.ttsDesign: Booming Texas oil tycoon, man about 60, big West Texas drawl, deep chesty baritone, loud and jovial, larger-than-life showman, low pitch, high energy.
tex.sample: Outta my way, I'm late for a merger!

nan.name: Nana
nan.blurb: Bakes for the whole aerodrome. Remembers every slight. Every single one.
nan.ttsDesign: Yorkshire grandmother, about 78, broad Yorkshire accent, sweet and warm on the surface with steel underneath, soft but firm, slightly creaky, medium pitch, unhurried.
nan.sample: Shift, love, or I'll tell your mother.

prince.name: The Young Prince
prince.blurb: Eleventh in line, first in panic. Apologises to the clouds.
prince.ttsDesign: Nervous young English aristocrat, man about 19, posh Received Pronunciation, breathless and stammering, voice cracking upward when excited, fast and apologetic, medium-high pitch.

charmer.name: The Charmer
charmer.blurb: Talked his way into the peerage and out of nine fines. Working on the tenth.
charmer.ttsDesign: Silver-tongued Irish man, about 40, soft lilting Dublin accent, warm, flirtatious and playful, smiling voice, easy musical rhythm, medium-low pitch.
charmer.sample: Ah, sorry now. You don't mind, sure you don't?

tower_m.name: Gerald Calloway
tower_m.blurb: 31 years in the tower, three of them calm. Collects ceramic owls.
tower_m.ttsDesign: Calm professional English air traffic controller, man about 58, neutral southern English accent, measured radio cadence, weary and patient, capable of cracking into exasperation, medium-low pitch.
tower_m.sample: Line up and wait. And wait. Please wait.

tower_f.name: Imogen Frost
tower_f.blurb: Flawless phraseology. Has never raised her voice. Yet.
tower_f.ttsDesign: Icy professional English air traffic controller, woman about 40, crisp precise Received Pronunciation, cool and controlled, clipped sentences, cutting understatement, medium pitch.
tower_f.sample: Extend downwind. Think about what you've done.

tower_trainee.name: Toby Wren
tower_trainee.blurb: First week on the job. Laminated cards. Thinks you're all wonderful.
tower_trainee.ttsDesign: Panicky junior English air traffic controller, young man about 21, light English accent, eager and friendly but nervous, voice rising in pitch when stressed, rushed delivery, medium-high pitch.
tower_trainee.sample: Go around! Go around! Sorry! Go around!

tower_farm.name: Farmer Mudge
tower_farm.blurb: Runs C-Tower 2 from the milking parlour at Muckle Bottom. Has never wanted an airfield. Has one anyway.
tower_farm.ttsDesign: A grumpy old English farmer in his sixties from rural Somerset with a broad West Country accent: burring rolled r's, broad slow vowels, 'oi' for 'I'. A low, rough, weathered baritone, an ordinary adult male speaking voice at normal volume, dry, grudging and unimpressed, slow unhurried delivery.
tower_farm.sample: Land on the grass, not the cows.

tower_butler.name: Mr Fennimore
tower_butler.blurb: The Royal Butler, C-Tower 3 on the Palace Lawn. Runs the radio from a silver tray. Has never been flustered, and does not intend to start.
tower_butler.ttsDesign: An elderly English butler in his seventies with an impeccable, old-fashioned Received Pronunciation accent. A low, soft, slightly dry baritone, an ordinary adult male speaking voice at normal volume, slow, measured and unflappable, perfectly polite, with very dry understatement.

tower_raf.name: Imogen Frost
tower_raf.blurb: Squadron Leader at RAF Much Snoring (C-Tower 4). Same Imogen, same voice, military frequency.
tower_raf.sample: Off. My. Runway. That is not a request.
